metadata.date_certainty_policy: emit only evidence-scoped future dates/ranges; generic announcement dates and unknown windows are excluded

date_certainty_contract.CONFIRMED_DATE: one explicit future date or a still-future boundary of an already-started confirmed range
date_certainty_contract.CONFIRMED_RANGE: ordered explicit official start/end bounds; emitted only while the whole range is future
date_certainty_contract.EXPECTED_WINDOW: requires ordered bounds, OFFICIAL source_tier and window_semantics_source=OFFICIAL_EXPECTED_WINDOW; confidence=MEDIUM
date_certainty_contract.UNKNOWN: never inserted into dated buckets; counted in excluded plan date semantics

metadata.window_semantics: non-overlapping calendar-day buckets: 0-7, 8-30, 31-90, >90; ranges are bucketed by start
metadata.dedupe_policy: logical aliases: source_event_id OR same provider+source_document_id OR exact canonical title; event_type and event_date must also match
metadata.source_failure_policy: terminal source failures fail closed: FAILED without a usable source; PARTIAL when mixed with usable or degraded sources
metadata.trading_day_policy: authoritative market calendar only; outside coverage/calendar errors remain UNVERIFIED
metadata.overlap_policy: same exact event_date; no trading interpretation

metadata.semantic_policy: market-cap fields are provider observations; share denominators are dated disclosures; no valuation inference

provenance.method: minute cumulative turnover differencing; newest incomplete minute excluded
